name: face landmarks resolve into a before/after retouch readout
looks: A close portrait gets a mesh of small landmark dots across the skin, then the frame splits down the middle into a before/after: one side untouched, the other smoothed and lit. A headline reads 'Flawless in one tap.' beside it, and a small panel of checked parameters (a blemish count, a skin-tone percentage, a light value) ticks in one after another next to the result.
build: The landmark dots are a seeded point field positioned over a face crop, fading in on a light stagger. The before/after is a hard vertical clip-path split with a thin divider line. The parameter panel is a slider-style readout: each row's label fades in, then its value ticks up to its final number in sync with a live change in the photo, one row settling before the next starts, power2.inOut.
sound: A soft shutter-like tick as the landmarks appear, a light whoosh on the split, a tick per parameter settling.
prompt: Show an AI edit as cause and effect: landmark points settle over a photo, then the frame splits into a clean before/after. Beside it, reveal two or three parameters one at a time, each value ticking up as its visible result changes in the photo at the same moment, so the viewer reads the number and the result as one thing.
